name: penny
for: meter what a service's customers use, enforce free/paid tier limits, and charge them: quota-config.json, the quota middleware, billing (ledger) and payment (Stripe plans, checkout, portal, subscriptions)

hands_off_to.for: installing authsetup, environments, minting/rotating billing and payment keys, authsetup errors
relationship-based access inside the client's app

answers: does service X meter usage, and which billing/payment write permissions should it ask the provider for
what tier is customer org Y on according to billing, and what limits does the quota config give that tier
is the quota library enforcing or in shadow on this deployment (from quotactl capabilities, with consent)
what does billing/payment/quota message <message> mean and what is the fix
which idempotency key does this money write need
dangerous_defaults: authsetup targets prod when no --env is given
enforcement.enabled absent means every request is allowed
quotactl capabilities and doctor connect to Redis and may create declared DynamoDB tables
setting AB0T_QUOTA_BILLING_URL turns paid mode on: Setup refuses to start without a durable outbox unless outbox.allow_ephemeral is true
the auth-event receiver answers 404 unless mounted with http.StripPrefix
